abba.json gap cases predate final regex; use gap-abba.json and gap-leading-abba.json for gap results.
lstrip prototype discarded because small leading gaps copied entire clean suffix.

result.json.conclusion: Uppercase realistic workloads consistently reduce CPU 18-21%. Lowercase general workloads essentially unchanged. Worst-case lowercase all-wildcard CPU increases 2.5%. Wall times are noisy under shared-host load; no general wall-speedup claim. Whole-process RSS is essentially unchanged (45.86 vs45.94 MiB fresh workers).

differential.result: all identical including warnings, exception types, message, and suppress_context

summary.json.benchmark: production_paired.py: same-process ABBA/BAAB x4, 16 observations per side, 2 warmups; fixed RNG 20261023; 100 inner calls for 10 and 1000 elements, otherwise one call.
summary.json.change: Reuse per-bin count and share sparse flatnonzero index scan across probability/target gathers while retaining original comparison boundaries, selection order, mean reductions, and dense/noncontiguous/shape-mismatch/scalar behavior.
summary.json.dense_result: 1 bin and all-0/all-1/two-occupied-bin distributions: median CPU ratios 0.959/0.991/0.975/0.993; no material regression. Wall measurements of small/dense cases are noisy and not used for claims.
summary.json.limitations: Local focused checks only. Full repository quick/core/ml/quality entrypoints and CI are parent-owned. Synthetic performance/equivalence tests make no biological accuracy/calibration claim. Benchmark has host contention; CPU times and two independent paired runs support the large sparse-bin result. No commit performed by subagent.
summary.json.main_result: 1,000,000 elements / 10 bins: median CPU 52.6675 -> 27.521 ms (-47.75%); median wall 183.710229 -> 87.1803755 ms (-52.54%). Full output JSON SHA-256 identical.
summary.json.memory: production paired tracemalloc: 10 bins 3,000,848 -> 2,804,184 bytes; 50 bins 3,004,792 -> 2,166,320 bytes; dense cases differ by only 192 bytes. Fresh-process RSS fluctuates 55-59 MB, so no RSS improvement claim.
summary.json.profile: prototypes.prof: 0.255 of 0.285 seconds in reliability_bins direct comparison/gather work on 1,000,000 elements / 50 bins; reduction methods took 0.028 seconds.
validation: Core Python 3.12: 303 tests passed (218 newly added tests plus related localize boundaries/scientific/efficiency tests); six established empty-bootstrap RuntimeWarnings.
Ruff check/format passed for both files; git diff --check passed.
